questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.To jog means to ______.

options.explain: correct — to jog is to run at a slow, steady pace

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.To quit means to ______.

options.explain: correct — to quit means to stop/give up

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.To reduce means to ______.

options.explain: correct — to reduce means to make smaller/less

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.To assist means to ______.

options.explain: correct — to assist means to help

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.I am looking forward to ______ you some day.

options.explain: wrong form after "to" as a preposition here

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.The opposite of failure is ______.
Circle the best answer.The opposite of enemy is ______.
Circle the best answer.The opposite of agree is ______.
Circle the best answer.What is she doing? – ______.

options.explain: correct — a natural short answer meaning she's not busy

questions.prompt: Circle the best answer.Ba is sociable but his brother is quite ______.

options.explain: means the same as sociable, doesn't contrast

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in capital letters.All ______ between Paris and Hanoi have been cancelled due to fog. (FLY)
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in capital letters.There is plenty of ______ for young people in this city. (ENTERTAIN)
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in capital letters.It's ______ to complain; you won't get your money back. (USE)
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in capital letters.During his ______ the family used to live in the countryside. (CHILD)
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in capital letters.He is such an ______ person that no one likes him. (HELP)
Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.My friend ______ the answer to the question now.

options.explain: wrong voice — the friend knows, isn't known
"know" is a stative verb, not used in continuous

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.I think I'll buy this pair of shoes. They ______ me really well.

options.explain: wrong tense for this general statement

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.I'll tell my uncle all the news when I ______ him.

options.explain: future tense not used in a time clause with "when"
not used in a time clause with "when"
correct — present simple for future time clauses
future tense not used in a time clause with "when"

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.I've got my key. I found it when I ______ for something else.

options.explain: simple past doesn't show the background action in progress
wrong tense for a past narrative
not a complete verb form here
correct — past continuous for the background action

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank."All these photographs ______ with a very cheap camera," he said.
Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.I wondered ______ the tickets were on sale yet.

options.explain: wrong question word for a yes/no question
wrong meaning — not asking about time
wrong meaning — not asking about place

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Dinner will be ready soon. Can you please ______ the table?

options.explain: correct — "lay the table" is the fixed expression

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Our neighbors are very ______ on camping holidays.

options.explain: correct — "keen on" is the fixed collocation

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.There is someone following us. I think we ______ in this area.

options.explain: wrong voice — "we" are receiving the action
wrong aspect — needs continuous for an ongoing action

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Walt Disney ______ the character of Mickey Mouse.

options.explain: wrong voice — Walt Disney is the one who created it
wrong tense for a completed historical fact

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Would you like to go to the cinema? – No, thanks. I'd ______ stay at home.

options.explain: "had better" needs "had", not "'d" alone in this pattern here
"I'd like" doesn't fit this preference structure with a bare verb

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Did they ask you what examinations you've ______?
Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.The Caspian Sea, a salt lake, is ______ any other lake in the world.

options.explain: superlative doesn't fit this comparison structure
superlative doesn't fit this comparison structure
"the" doesn't belong before a comparative used this way

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Most people prefer ______ money to ______ it.

options.explain: second verb needs a gerund too

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Our teacher made us ______ harder.

options.explain: wrong form — "make" takes a bare infinitive

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.The plane will ______ in a few minutes.

options.explain: correct — both "take off" and "land" fit this sentence grammatically

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.The teacher told the student ______.

options.explain: wrong structure — "that" is redundant after "what to do"

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.He is used to ______ in public.

options.explain: wrong form — needs a gerund after "used to" here

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.Do you think I should practice ______ English every day? – Yes, if you want to improve it.
Choose the best answer to fill in the blank.I am not old enough ______ the car.
Choose the word or phrase that needs correcting.Peter, I'd would you like some to meet.

options.explain: incorrect — should be “I'd (remove ‘would’)” — the odd one out

questions.prompt: Choose the word or phrase that needs correcting.It is greatly to be with you on such a lovely day.

options.explain: incorrect — should be “great” — the odd one out

questions.prompt: Choose the word or phrase that needs correcting.Would you mind to go to the local bookshop to get me some papers?

options.word: to go to the local bookshop
options.explain: incorrect — should be “going to the local bookshop” — the odd one out

questions.prompt: Choose the word or phrase that needs correcting.I think I prefer country life more than city life.

options.explain: incorrect — should be “to” — the odd one out

questions.prompt: Choose the word or phrase that needs correcting.Thanks for invite me to the water-fetching contest of your school.

options.explain: incorrect — should be “for inviting” — the odd one out
